name: Jalapeno Popper Chicken Casserole
note: In-band (418 cal / 2g carbs), cream-cheese/sour-cream/cheddar-bound crustless chicken bake, jalapeno-forward, no starch. Distinct from accepted chicken-bacon-ranch-cauliflower-bake (ranch + cauliflower, different flavor family) - jalapeno popper is a distinct Tex-Mex flavor. Cross-lane merge resolved: the pending pool candidate jalapeno-popper-chicken-cauliflower-bake is the SAME dish (jalapeno popper chicken bake, cream cheese + bacon + cheddar + jalapeno) with only a cauliflower add; this no-starch casserole is the cleaner low-carb keep, so that variant will be rejected as a pool-dupe when it reaches me. Cross-protein jalapeno-popper turkey/beef bakes would be the same dish in another protein - none accepted, none pending seen; future-lane watch.
